s2:Rapid destruction of planetary debris around white dwarfs through aeolian erosio

rationale: None of the candidate papers directly investigate the mechanisms responsible for transporting matter to the white dwarf surface in WD debris disks. They focus on related topics such as debris disk properties, pollution, and erosion processes.
